subtitle: Out Manila · Juneyao Airlines
overview: Fly Juneyao Airlines to Shanghai and travel through Shanghai, Wuxi and Hangzhou, staying five nights in 4★ hotels. Sights include the Bund, Nianhua Bay (Mini Kyoto), Nanxun Ancient Town by boat, West Lake and the Lujiazui skywalk, with a free upgrade to a BBQ lunch and a Yuyuan hot pot. Day 5 is free, with optional Shanghai Disneyland.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 7–12 2026 to Mar 21–26 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.The Bund: Shanghai's riverside promenade lined with historic buildings, with views across the Huangpu River.
placeDesc.Oriental Pearl Tower: A landmark TV tower in Pudong with spheres on its frame; the tour makes a photo stop.
placeDesc.Zhang Garden: A historic garden complex in central Shanghai with traditional buildings, visited on the first day.
placeDesc.Huaihai Road: A major shopping street in the former French Concession of Shanghai.
placeDesc.Nianhua Bay (Mini Kyoto): A Wuxi tourist town on Taihu Lake with Japanese-inspired architecture, seen as a night view.
placeDesc.Nanxun Ancient Town: A Jiangnan water town with canals and old mansions; a boat ride is included.
placeDesc.West Lake: Hangzhou's famous freshwater lake, a UNESCO World Heritage site, explored on a stroll.
placeDesc.Jinniu Pond: A pond area by West Lake in Hangzhou, visited during the lakeside stroll.
placeDesc.Meijiawu Tea Garden: A tea-growing village near Hangzhou, with a Hanfu experience included.
placeDesc.Lujiazui Skywalk: An elevated walkway around the Lujiazui financial district in Pudong with skyscraper views.
placeDesc.Shanghai Disneyland: Optional free-day tour: the Disney theme park in Pudong, with ticket, transfers and guide.
placeDesc.Jinmao Tower: A landmark skyscraper in Pudong; the optional tour visits the 88th floor sightseeing hall.
placeDesc.Xintiandi: A Shanghai dining and shopping district of restored Shikumen stone-gate houses, part of an optional tour.
placeDesc.Chenghuang Temple: A traditional-style business area around the City God Temple in Shanghai, given as free shopping time.
